description: This file defines a comprehensive framework for initializing various project templates, including classes for project configuration, template management, and execution of pre- and post-processing scripts. It includes multiple template subclasses for different project types, a helper for copying templates with variable replacements, and a main function demonstrating usage.

classes.name: ProcessingStep
classes.description: Enum for processing steps, used to distinguish pre- and post-processing scripts.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Manages template locations and access, providing template paths based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectTemplate
classes.description: Abstract base class for project templates, providing common initialization, structure generation, testing setup, and script execution logic.

classes.name: ProjectTemplateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for registering and creating project template instances based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main orchestrator class that manages project initialization and waiting for post-processing completion.

classes.name: FileSystemHelper
classes.description: Helper class for copying template files with variable replacements, including handling hidden files and exclusions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the project by validating parameters, running pre-processing, generating structure, setting up testing, and running post-processing.

methods.name: run_pre_processing
methods.description: Executes the pre-processing script if defined.

methods.name: run_post_processing
methods.description: Executes the post-processing script if defined.

methods.name: _run_processing_script
methods.description: Runs a processing script either synchronously (pre-processing) or in the background (post-processing) with status management.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits for the post-processing to complete successfully within a specified timeout.
